title: Kubernetes v1.37 推进面向工作负载的调度
english: The Kubernetes Blog describes v1.37 as the next major milestone in Workload-Aware Scheduling for AI/ML and complex batch workloads. The core Workload and PodGroup APIs, which enable gang scheduling, graduate to Beta, together with Workload-Aware Preemption and shared DRA ResourceClaims for PodGroups. The release also introduces the CompositePodGroup API for hierarchical scheduling requirements. It is designed to express multi-level topology constraints, gang scheduling, and preemption policies for complex, heterogeneous workloads. For senior operations and development engineers, the announcement highlights a shift from scheduling individual Pods toward expressing workload-level coordination and resource relationships. This direction is relevant to platform engineering, distributed workload operations, and infrastructure supporting AI/ML systems, while the supplied source does not provide further implementation details or performance figures.
chinese: Kubernetes Blog称，v1.37是 Workload-Aware Scheduling（WAS）演进中的下一项重要里程碑，重点面向 AI/ML 与复杂批处理工作负载。Workload 和 PodGroup 核心 API（支持 gang scheduling）、Workload-Aware Preemption（WAP），以及供 PodGroup 使用的共享 DRA ResourceClaims 均进入 Beta。该版本还引入 CompositePodGroup API，用于表达多层拓扑约束、gang scheduling 和抢占策略，以支持复杂、异构的工作负载。提供的摘要未包含更多实现细节或性能数据。
why_it_matters: 这与云原生平台和 AI 基础设施直接相关：调度对象从单个 Pod 扩展到具备协同关系的工作负载，有助于资深运维开发理解分布式 AI/ML 与批处理系统的资源编排方向。对 AIOps 和 Agent Infra 而言，工作负载级拓扑、抢占与资源声明可作为平台自动化和运行治理需要关注的基础能力。职业发展上，应重视 Kubernetes 调度、资源抽象、异构工作负载和平台工程能力。
interview_expression: I have been following Kubernetes’ move toward workload-level scheduling, especially gang scheduling and workload-aware preemption. These capabilities are relevant when operating complex, heterogeneous AI/ML and batch workloads.

sources.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Advancing Workload-Aware Scheduling
sources.summary:
AI/ML and complex batch workloads continue to push the boundaries of Kubernetes scheduling. Following the foundational workload-centric enhancements introduced in previous releases, Kubernetes v1.37 delivers the next major milestone in the Workload-Aware Scheduling (WAS) journey. In this release, the core Workload and PodGroup APIs—enabling gang scheduling—along with Workload-Aware Preemption (WAP) and shared DRA ResourceClaims for PodGroups, all graduate to Beta, solidifying their role in the Kubernetes ecosystem.
